notes: postresp_slot0 and postresp_slot2 hold template, newline, role and dialogue tokens only (user, response, 回答, interpret). postresp_slot3 is dominated by follow-up-question tokens (continue, why, thank, okay); its few act words have small n. postresp_slot1 carries most act words. postresp_slot4 mixes act words with user-stance words (skepticism, suspicion, accusations, rumors), which are logged under exclusions. Fiction/scenario/role-play tokens at postresp_slot4 were not treated as candidates. Stance adverbs at postresp_slot1 (politely, confidently, subtly, firmly) and generic speech words (claim, assert, narrative) were not treated as candidates.
